item.title: Thrasides #2544 the Twice-Born was broken and is whole again (2×). The House of Chthonius
item.description: Thrasides #2544 the Twice-Born was broken and is whole again (2×). The House of Chthonius made room at the fire, but no one sat close. Thrasides has drunk from Lethe 2 times and remembers little.
